arxiv-2101-11220.title: Coherent dynamics of multi-spin V B − \rm V_{B}^{-} centers in hexagonal boron nitride
arxiv-2101-11220.creator: Wei Liu, Viktor Ivády, Zhi-Peng Li, Yuan-Ze Yang, Shang Yu, Yu Meng, Zhao-An Wang, Nai-Jie Guo, Fei-Fei Yan, Qiang Li, Jun-Feng Wang, Jin-Shi Xu, Xiao Liu, Zong-Quan Zhou, Yang Dong, Xiang-Dong Chen, Fang-Wen Sun, Yi-Tao Wang, Jian-Shun Tang, Adam Gali, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo
arxiv-2101-11220.description: Abstract Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) has recently been demonstrated to contain optically polarized and detected electron spins that can be utilized for implementing qubits and quantum sensors in nanolayered-devices. Understanding the coherent dynamics of microwave driven spins in hBN is of crucial importance for advancing these emerging new technologies.

arxiv-2103-15503.title: Orientational instability of the director in a nematic cell caused by electro-induced anchoring modification
arxiv-2103-15503.creator: O.S. Tarnavskyy, M.F. Ledney
arxiv-2103-15503.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the threshold for the director reorientation from the homeotropic state to the hybrid homeotropic-planar state and vice versa in a cell filled with a flexoelectric nematic liquid crystal (NLC) subjected to an electric field. The liquid crystal is doped by a CTAB-like substance, a part of molecules of which dissociates into positive and negative ions.

arxiv-2107-10179.title: Scattering in Black Hole Backgrounds and Higher-Spin Amplitudes: Part I
arxiv-2107-10179.creator: Yilber Fabian Bautista, Alfredo Guevara, Chris Kavanagh, and Justin Vines
arxiv-2107-10179.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yilber Fabian Bautista, Alfredo Guevara, Chris Kavanagh, and Justin Vines. The scattering of massless waves of helicity | h | = 0 , 1 2 , 1 |h|=0,\frac{1}{2},1 in Schwarzschild and Kerr backgrounds is revisited in the long-wavelength regime. Using a novel description of such backgrounds in terms of gravitating massive particles, we compute classical wave scattering in terms of 2 → 2 2\to 2 QFT amplitudes in flat space, to all orders in spin.

arxiv-2305-08246.title: Learning Non-linguistic Skills without Sacrificing Linguistic Proficiency
arxiv-2305-08246.creator: Mandar Sharma, Nikhil Muralidhar, Naren Ramakrishnan
arxiv-2305-08246.description: Abstract The field of Math-NLP has witnessed significant growth in recent years, motivated by the desire to expand LLM performance to the learning of non-linguistic notions (numerals, and subsequently, arithmetic reasoning). However, non-linguistic skill injection typically comes at a cost for LLMs: it leads to catastrophic forgetting of core linguistic skills, a consequence that often remains unaddressed in the literature.

arxiv-2308-04056.title: Portrayal : Leveraging NLP and Visualization for Analyzing Fictional Characters Conference: Designing Interactive Systems Conference; July 10–14, 2023; Pittsburgh, PA, USA Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS ’23), July 10–14, 2023, Pittsburgh, PA, USA DOI: 10.1145/3563657.3596000 ISBN: 978
arxiv-2308-04056.creator: Md Naimul Hoque, Bhavya Ghai, Kari Kraus, Niklas Elmqvist
arxiv-2308-04056.description: Abstract . Many creative writing tasks (e.g., fiction writing) require authors to write complex narrative components (e.g., characterization, events, dialogue) over the course of a long story. Similarly, literary scholars need to manually annotate and interpret texts to understand such abstract components.

arxiv-2311-03550.title: United We Stand, Divided We Fall: UnityGraph for Unsupervised Procedure Learning from Videos
arxiv-2311-03550.creator: Siddhant Bansal, Chetan Arora, C.V. Jawahar
arxiv-2311-03550.description: Abstract Given multiple videos of the same task, procedure learning addresses identifying the key-steps and determining their order to perform the task. For this purpose, existing approaches use the signal generated from a pair of videos. This makes key-steps discovery challenging as the algorithms lack inter-videos perspective. Instead, we propose an unsupervised Graph-based Procedure Learning (GPL) framework.

arxiv-2312-06024.title: Thinking Assistants : LLM-Based Conversational Assistants that Help Users Think By Asking rather than Answering
arxiv-2312-06024.creator: Soya Park, Hari Subramonyam, Chinmay Kulkarni
arxiv-2312-06024.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Soya Park, Hari Subramonyam, Chinmay Kulkarni. Many AI systems focus solely on providing solutions or explaining outcomes. However, complex tasks like research and strategic thinking often benefit from a more comprehensive approach to augmenting the thinking process rather than passively getting information. We introduce the concept of “Thinking Assistants”, a new genre of assistants that help users improve decision-making with a combination of asking reflection questions based on expert knowledge.

arxiv-2403-03945.title: SPEAR : Exact Gradient Inversion of Batches in Federated Learning
arxiv-2403-03945.creator: Dimitar I. Dimitrov, Maximilian Baader, Mark Niklas Müller, Martin Vechev, {dimitar.iliev.dimitrov}@insait.ai, {mbaader, mark.mueller, martin.vechev}@inf.ethz.ch
arxiv-2403-03945.description: Abstract Federated learning is a framework for collaborative machine learning where clients only share gradient updates and not their private data with a server. However, it was recently shown that gradient inversion attacks can reconstruct this data from the shared gradients.

arxiv-2411-09292.title: The rotation properties of δ \delta Sct and γ \gamma Dor stars
arxiv-2411-09292.creator: Jiyu Wang, Xiaodian Chen, Licai Deng, Jianxing Zhang, Weijia Sun
arxiv-2411-09292.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiyu Wang, Xiaodian Chen, Licai Deng, Jianxing Zhang, Weijia Sun. Based on the LAMOST spectroscopy and TESS time-series photometry, we have obtained a main-sequence star sample of δ \delta Scuti and γ \gamma Doradus stars. The sample includes 1534 δ \delta Sct stars, 367 γ \gamma Dor stars, 1703 δ \delta Sct | γ |\gamma Dor stars, 270 γ \gamma Dor | δ |\delta Sct stars, along with 105 ‘dsct candidates’ and 32 ‘gdor candidates’.

arxiv-2502-02964.title: Boundary regularity for the polyharmonic Dirichlet problem
arxiv-2502-02964.creator: Antoine Lemenant and Rémy Mougenot
arxiv-2502-02964.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Antoine Lemenant and Rémy Mougenot. In this paper we prove that any solution of the m m -polyharmonic Poisson equation in a Reifenberg-flat domain with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition, is 𝒞 m − 1 , α \mathscr{C}^{m-1,\alpha} regular up to the boundary. To achieve this result we extend the Nirenberg method of translations to operators of arbitrary order, and then use some Mosco-convergence tools developped in a previous paper [ 12 ] .

arxiv-2506-00548.title: 𝖢𝗈𝗇 ​ 𝖨𝗇𝗌𝗍𝗋𝗎𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 \mathsf{Con\ Instruction} : Universal Jailbreaking of Multimodal Large Language Models via Non-Textual Modalities
arxiv-2506-00548.creator: Jiahui Geng, Thy Thy Tran, Preslav Nakov, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2506-00548.description: Abstract Existing attacks against multimodal language models (MLLMs) primarily communicate instructions through text accompanied by adversarial images. In contrast, here we exploit the capabilities of MLLMs to interpret non-textual instructions–specifically adversarial images or audio–generated by our novel method, 𝖢𝗈𝗇 ​ 𝖨𝗇𝗌𝗍𝗋𝗎𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 \mathsf{Con\ Instruction} .

arxiv-2512-13943.title: Investigating the Reionization Epoch through 21 cm and Line Intensity Mapping Experiments
arxiv-2512-13943.creator: Anirban Roy, Anthony Pullen, Patrick C. Breysse, Rachel S. Somerville
arxiv-2512-13943.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anirban Roy, Anthony Pullen, Patrick C. Breysse, Rachel S. Somerville. The epoch of reionization (EoR), marking the Universe’s transition from a neutral to ionized state, represents a pivotal phase for understanding the formation of the first stars and galaxies. Intensity mapping of atomic and molecular lines, such as [ CII ] [\mathrm{CII}] and CO J-ladder transitions, across a broad redshift range is a powerful tool for investigating star formation history, metallicity, the distribution of gas and dust, and the physical conditions within galaxies.

pmc-10646536.title: Candidate composite biomarker to inform drug treatments for diabetic kidney disease
pmc-10646536.creator: Roger D. Jones, Seyum Abebe, Veronica Distefano, Gert Mayer, Irene Poli, Claudio Silvestri, Debora Slanzi
pmc-10646536.description: IntroductionCurrent guidelines recommend renin angiotensin system inhibitors (RASi) as key components of treatment of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). Additional options include sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP1a), and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MCRa). The identification of the optimum drug combination for an individual is difficult because of the inter-, and longitudinal intra-individual heterogeneity of response to therapy.

pmc-10670894.title: Fast and Accurate Multiplex Identification and Quantification of Seven Genetically Modified Soybean Lines Using Six-Color Digital PCR
pmc-10670894.creator: Alexandra Bogožalec Košir, Sabine Muller, Jana Žel, Mojca Milavec, Allison C. Mallory, David Dobnik
pmc-10670894.description: The proliferation of genetically modified organisms (GMOs) presents challenges to GMO testing laboratories and policymakers. Traditional methods, like quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR), face limitations in quantifying the increasing number of GMOs in a single sample. Digital PCR (dPCR), specifically multiplexing, offers a solution by enabling simultaneous quantification of multiple GMO targets.

pmc-10674177.title: Robust H-Infinity Tracking Control for a Valve-Controlled Hydraulic Motor System with Uncertain Parameters in the Complex Load Environment
pmc-10674177.creator: Kunwei Lu, Guodong Feng, Beichen Ding, Miguel Delgado-Prieto
pmc-10674177.description: A valve-controlled hydraulic motor system operating in a complex environment is subject to complex load changes. In extreme cases, the load can be regarded as a disturbance signal with complex frequency and strong amplitude fluctuations, which greatly affects the speed stability of the hydraulic motor and reduces the operating efficiency.

pmc-11430567.title: Characterization of HER2-Low Breast Tumors among a Cohort of Colombian Women
pmc-11430567.creator: Laura Rey-Vargas, Lina María Bejarano-Rivera, Diego Felipe Ballen, Silvia J Serrano-Gómez, Hiroyuki Takei
pmc-11430567.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryHER2-low breast cancer is a newly recognized subtype that has shown promising responses to treatment with antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs). However, there is still little known about its clinical and molecular characteristics. In this study, we examined the clinical and pathological features, survival rates, and expression of HER2-related genes in Colombian patients with HER2-low breast cancer, comparing them to HER2-negative and positive groups. We found that HER2-low tumors were better differentiated and had a lower proliferation index compared to HER2-positive tumors.

pmc-11512814.title: Extending radiowave frequency detection range with dressed states of solid-state spin ensembles
pmc-11512814.creator: Jens C. Hermann, Roberto Rizzato, Fleming Bruckmaier, Robin D. Allert, Aharon Blank, Dominik B. Bucher
pmc-11512814.description: Quantum sensors using solid-state spin defects excel in the detection of radiofrequency (RF) fields, serving various applications in communication, ranging, and sensing. For this purpose, pulsed dynamical decoupling (PDD) protocols are typically applied, which enhance sensitivity to RF signals. However, these methods are limited to frequencies of a few megahertz, which poses a challenge for sensing higher frequencies.

pmc-11541454.title: Nanoencapsulation of vitamin D3 by ultrasonic pretreated zein hydrolysates: Stability improvement in food models
pmc-11541454.creator: Bahare Sadr, Mahnaz Tabibiazar, Ainaz Alizadeh, Hamed Hamishehkar, Leila Roufegarinejad, Sajed Amjadi
pmc-11541454.description: This work is aimed to assess the effect of ultrasonic pre-treatment on the enzymatic hydrolysis of zein and the nanoencapsulation of vitamin D3 (VitD3) by zein hydrolysates (ZH). The ultrasonic pre-treatment significantly increased the degree of hydrolysis by and the α-helix, β-sheet, β-turns contents, and random coils were enhanced by ultrasonic pre-treatment.

pmc-11587070.title: Physical Activity Levels During Physical Education Classes and Their Impact on Physical Fitness in 10-Year-Old School Children: A Comparative Study
pmc-11587070.creator: Vladan Pelemiš, Slobodan Pavlović, Nebojša Mitrović, Ivko Nikolić, Dalibor Stević, Nebojša Trajković, José M Gamonales, Mário André da Cunha Espada
pmc-11587070.description: Background/Objectives: The aim of this research was to determine the differences in physical fitness according to the level of physical activity (PA) during physical education classes in 10-year-old school children. Methods: The research included 315 primary school children (age 10 ± 1.3 years), divided into three groups by level of PA: low, moderate and high.

pmc-12721343.title: Rapid axially scanned and de-scanned line-scan confocal microscopy with a tunable acoustic gradient index of refraction lens for high-speed volumetric in vivo imaging
pmc-12721343.creator: Khuong Duy Mac, Suhyeon Kim, Tien Nhat Nguyen, Christine Hwang, Minsung Kim, Rui Liu, Yan Liu, Joon Heon Kim, Young Ro Kim, Euiheon Chung, Hyuk-Sang Kwon
pmc-12721343.description: .SignificanceRapid acquisition of high-resolution volumetric images has been critical to effectively monitor dynamic biological processes in vivo, yet it faces tradeoffs between image resolution, penetration depth, and imaging speed. These limitations hinder the ability to study rapid neurophysiological events such as cerebrovascular dynamics and cellular activity, highlighting the need for advanced high-speed 3D imaging system.

pmc-12744588.title: Advancing Hepatocellular Carcinoma Therapy with Next-Generation Molecular and Immunotherapeutics
pmc-12744588.creator: Mudassir Hassan, Ijaz Hussain, Kafeel Ahmad, Saima Zafar, Adeel Khalid, Muhammad Haseeb, Nazim Hussain, Muhammad Adeel Ghafar
pmc-12744588.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), the most prevalent form of primary liver cancer, remains a major global health concern due to its high incidence and mortality rates. Driven by factors such as chronic hepatitis B and C infections, alcohol-related liver disease, and metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), HCC is often diagnosed at advanced stages, limiting therapeutic options and prognosis.

pmc-13465251.creator: Masami Masuda-Suzukake, Masato Hasegawa, Takashi Nonaka
pmc-13465251.description: Intraneuronal α-synuclein (αS) accumulation is a central event in the pathogenesis of Parkinson’s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies. The spread of αS pathology throughout the central nervous system contributes to disease progression via seed-dependent propagation, yet disease-modifying therapies remain unavailable.

pmc-13576209.title: International study of 24-hour movement behaviours among preschool children (SUNRISE): A pilot study from Nepal
pmc-13576209.creator: Narayan Subedi, Anthony D Okely, Buna Bhandari, Susan Paudel
